units.source_text: 不知怎的，我感到仿佛有个美丽的小小的彩色旋涡似的东西。

en.t: Somehow, I felt as though there were something like a beautiful little swirl of color.

units.source_text: 我想，它可能是刚才看到的壁项图案的五色斑斓的残影吧。

en.t: I thought it was probably the richly colored afterimage of the pattern on the wall panel I had just seen.

units.source_text: 凝聚了丰富色彩的感觉，就像那只迹陵频枷鸟，

en.t: The sensation of abundant colors gathered together was like that Jiling pinjia bird,

units.source_text: 隐栖在嫩叶丛中和郁葱的松枝上，

en.t: hidden among clusters of young leaves and on lush pine branches,

units.source_text: 只让人从缝隙看到它华丽的翅膀的一端。

en.t: letting one see only the tip of its splendid wing through the gaps.
